TeraBox is more than just cloud storage — it’s your smart AI assistant. Store, organize, and share large files in seconds, then let AI help you search for anything, make stunning photos and videos, and unlock handy smart tools. Register now to get 1024GB of free cloud storage and explore endless possibilities with AI!

KEY FEATURES
[NEW] Tera AI: All-in-One AI Agent
Ask anything and get real answers. Turn photos into highlight reels, posters, and cards in a tap. Summarize a long PDF or pull the key details out of a screenshot. Search, create, and get things done — all in one place, without leaving the app.

[NEW] AI Study: Turn Files into Notes & Quizzes
AI Study turns anything you save into something you actually learn. Drop in a file and get clear structured notes in seconds — or record a lecture or meeting live and let AI listen and take the notes for you. Then quiz yourself, review with flashcards, and see how the ideas connect on a mind map. Less time organizing, more time understanding.

Automatic Data Backup
Automatically back up your photos, videos, documents and even folders to TeraBox cloud storage. Keep everything synchronized and accessible from any mobile device or computer — wherever you are.

Ultra-Large File Transfer
Upload, store, and share big files up to 128 GB seamlessly. Whether you need to send big video files, massive document archives, or high-res media, TeraBox supports big file sharing quickly with a secure link. No size limits holding you back.

AI-Powered Search
Built-in AI browser lets you search smarter instantly. Quickly find what you need, watch trending videos, discover the latest movies, or follow hot topics—all within TeraBox. Search, browse, and watch, all in one place.

AI Image Creation & Editing
Transform your photos into AI art with just one tap. Try creative AI styles like Snoopy, Miyazaki, or Cyberpunk, or enhance your portraits with built-in beauty effects.

AI Video Generation
Turn your ideas or photos into creative videos in seconds. Choose from a variety of dynamic effects to quickly generate viral videos for social media, promos, or personal projects.

AI Transcription
Convert voice to text. Record live and see the transcript appear as you speak, or upload any audio or video file. Get accurate, readable transcripts with key points summarized automatically — saving you hours of manual note-taking.

HD Video Player + AI Subtitles
Enjoy smooth, high-definition video playback within TeraBox. Our AI automatically generates accurate subtitles for lectures, foreign films, or personal videos, making it easier to follow and understand every word.

AI Scanning & PDF Document Management
Quickly scan multiple documents and edit your PDFs easily. TeraBox automatically recognizes text, helping you organize and clean up digital files.

Other Advanced AI Tools
Explore more built-in AI features such as AI Sketch, handwriting removal, translation, and image compression. TeraBox is your ultimate AI toolbox for every daily need.


HIGHLIGHTS
- 1024GB Free Storage: Safely back up millions of photos, videos, and documents.
- Large File Uploads & Sharing: Easily send big files to anyone via secure links.
- Privacy Protection: Advanced encryption keeps all your files safe.
- Multi-Device Sync: Access and sync all your files from any computer, tablet, or mobile phone.
- Intelligent Albums: Auto-categorize your photos for quick and easy browsing.

Sign up for TeraBox now to get 1TB of free cloud storage and enjoy a powerful portable AI assistant!

複数の文書をすばやくスキャンし、PDF ファイルを簡単に編集。TeraBoxはテキストを自動認識し、デジタルファイルの整理をサポートします。

AIスケッチ、手書き文字除去、翻訳、画像圧縮など、さらに多くの内蔵AI機能をお試しください。TeraBoxはあらゆるクリエイティブ・実用的なニーズに応えるスマートAIツールボックスです。

– 1024GB無料ストレージ：何百万もの写真、動画、ドキュメントを安全にバックアップ。

– スマートアルバム：写真を自動分類し、すばやく簡単にブラウズできます。

今すぐTeraBoxに登録して、1TBの無料クラウドストレージを手に入れ、強力でポータブルなAIアシスタントをお楽しみください！

MySA: Your All-in-One AI Assistant & Smart Personal Productivity Suite
Meet MySA, the next-generation AI assistant designed to transform how you manage your professional and personal life. In an era of information overload, MySA acts as your dedicated AI personal assistant, streamlining your calls, calendar, documents, and reminders into one secure, unified interface.

Whether you are a busy entrepreneur, a student, a business owner or a developer, MySA automates the "busy work" so you can focus on high-impact tasks. By leveraging intelligent automation to handle your scheduling and data processing, MySA transforms your workflow, allowing you to prioritize deep work and innovation over administrative overhead.

INTELLIGENT AI CALL ASSISTANT
Never miss a critical detail again. MySA provides a seamless AI call assistant experience that manages your telephonic interactions when you are unavailable.
Smart Call Assist: In a meeting or driving? Your AI assistant answers for you, interacts with callers in natural language, and understands their specific intent.
Instant Briefings: Get a concise text summary and a full audio recording from your AI assistant the second a call ends.
Spam & Intent Filtering: Let your AI assistant screen calls, ensuring only important messages reach your attention.

ADVANCED DOCUMENT INTELLIGENCE
Stop digging through folders. Use MySA as your personal AI document assistant to analyze complex information in seconds.
Interactive Document Chat: Upload PDFs, Word docs, or images and ask your AI assistant specific questions about the content.
Smart AI Summaries: Extract key data points, summarize long reports, or find specific clauses in legal documents instantly.
AI Image-to-Text (OCR): Turn photos of receipts, whiteboards, or handwritten notes into actionable digital text with a single tap.

UNIFIED AI CALENDAR & REMINDERS
MySA is a comprehensive AI calendar assistant that integrates your entire schedule into one view.
Seamless Ecosystem Sync: Fully integrated with Google and Outlook Calendar.
Natural Language AI Reminders: Set one-time or recurring tasks effortlessly. Simply say, "Remind me to call the client tomorrow at 10 AM," and your AI assistant handles the scheduling.
Intelligent Priority Sorting: MySA analyzes your tasks and reminders to suggest the best times for deep work and meetings.

HANDS-FREE AI VOICE INTERACTION
Boost your efficiency on the go with high-accuracy AI voice assistance.
Contextual Voice Notes: Dictate ideas or meeting minutes hands-free; your AI assistant organizes them into structured notes.
Memory & Personalization: As a smart AI assistant, MySA learns your preferences over time to provide increasingly personalized suggestions.
Multilingual Support: Communicate with your AI assistant in over 100+ languages, including major Indian regional languages.

PRIVACY-FIRST AI DESIGN
Your data privacy is our absolute priority. Unlike other tools, MySA is a private AI assistant built with "Privacy by Design" principles.
Enterprise-Grade Encryption: Your personal information and documents are protected with the highest level of security.
Secure Data Handling: We prioritize security, ensuring your personal information and documents remain 100% confidential.

COLLABORATIVE AI ECOSYSTEM
Shared AI Reminders: Set tasks for friends, family, or teammates. Once they accept, your AI assistant manages the follow-up, so you don’t have to.
Unified Productivity: Experience the future of personal and group coordination in one app.
Download MySA today and experience the future of personal productivity with your new favorite AI assistant.

PRIVACY and SECURITY
Your data is private and protected. MySmartAssistant is built with security-first architecture and respects your privacy.
Privacy Policy: https://mysmartassistant.ai/privacy
Terms: https://mysmartassistant.ai/terms

record.name: AI Trading Assistant: Chart AI
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Chart AI helps make technical charts easier to understand. Add a chart and receive an educational breakdown of its candlestick formations, trend direction, support and resistance areas, indicators and wider market context. The experience is built for people who want to learn chart analysis in a clear, practical way rather than work through disconnected definitions.

TURN A CHART INTO A LEARNING MOMENT
A single chart can contain several layers of information. Chart AI helps separate those layers and explain what each one represents, creating a focused starting point for further study.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPLORE
• Upload a chart image for an AI-assisted educational review
• Learn how common candlestick formations are described
• Examine visible trends and price structure
• Review possible support and resistance areas
• Explore technical indicators and what they are commonly used to measure
• Consider market sentiment and contextual information
• Study examples across shares, forex and crypto markets
• Return to important concepts whenever you need a refresher

For learners in the UK exploring shares, forex or crypto, the app provides a convenient place to practise reading charts and revisiting key concepts. It can complement independent study, finance coursework, market research exercises or an existing learning routine.

A SIMPLE STUDY WORKFLOW
1. Choose a clear chart from your device.
2. Upload it to begin the analysis.
3. Read the explanation section by section.
4. Compare the observations with the original image.
5. Use the result as a starting point for deeper learning and independent research.

LEARN WITH MORE CONTEXT
Chart reading is not about one pattern or indicator in isolation. Time frame, price structure, volatility, sentiment, and broader conditions can all affect interpretation. Chart AI presents several relevant chart elements together, making it easier to build vocabulary, notice relationships, and ask better questions as your knowledge develops.

The wording and examples suit users who commonly search for shares and market analysis, while the educational purpose remains clear throughout.

CLEAR, EDUCATIONAL POSITIONING
The app explains concepts in accessible language. It does not promise outcomes, replace your own judgement, or remove market uncertainty. Use the information to practice observation, strengthen your understanding, and continue learning from reliable educational sources.

IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Chart AI provides educational and informational content only. It does not provide investment recommendations or personalized financial guidance. Market activity involves risk, and any decision should be based on your own research, circumstances, and, where appropriate, guidance from a suitably qualified professional.

Lade einfach ein Foto von dir hoch und probiere mit unserem KI-Kleiderwechsler sofort Millionen von Outfits aus, um den Stil zu finden, der perfekt zu dir passt. Entdecke neue Looks in Sekundenschnelle und lass dich von Outfit-Ideen inspirieren, die zu deinem persönlichen Stil passen.

Spare Geld, indem du Fehlkäufe vermeidest und nur Outfits auswählst, die wirklich zu dir passen.

Und vor allem: Hab Spaß dabei, mit unserem KI-Kleiderwechsler neue Looks auf deine eigene Weise auszuprobieren.

Farbanalyse mit KI
Unser KI-Kleiderwechsler hilft dir dabei, Outfits in Farbtönen auszuprobieren, die zu deinem Hautton passen, und sogar neue Haarfarben virtuell zu testen.

Deine digitale Garderobe – neu gedacht
Lade deine Kleidung direkt in deinen persönlichen digitalen Kleiderschrank hoch. Der KI-Kleiderwechsler entfernt automatisch Hintergründe und erkennt jedes Kleidungsstück mit intelligenten Tags, damit deine Garderobe übersichtlich und inspirierend organisiert bleibt.

Mit dem Outfit-Generator und der virtuellen Anprobe von DLOOK kannst du deine Garderobe individuell gestalten, passende Outfits für jede Gelegenheit finden – ob für das Büro, entspannte Wochenenden oder elegante Abende – und deine Kombinationen bereits vor dem Tragen virtuell testen.

Kombiniere und arrangiere deine Kleidungsstücke auf einer intuitiven Arbeitsfläche, um deinen Wunschlook zu gestalten. Sieh sofort, wie verschiedene Teile zusammenwirken, und probiere jede Kombination virtuell mit dem KI-Kleiderwechsler aus.

Der intelligente Outfit-Generator von DLOOK ermöglicht es dir, deine Ergebnisse zu speichern, zu bearbeiten und immer wieder neu zu gestalten, damit dein perfekter Look jederzeit griffbereit ist.

AI Clothes Changer & Virtual Outfit Try On
Found a dress, a honeymoon outfit, or an outfit you love while scrolling online? Simply upload a screenshot or photo and instantly see how it looks on you before making a purchase. Abra um mundo de possibilidades com o ChatAI Assistant – o seu assistente inteligente!

O ChatAI Assistant é um aplicativo poderoso que ajuda você a resolver diversas tarefas e simplificar o seu dia a dia. - Gerador de ideias e textos criativos: Tenha ideias para projetos, propostas e pesquisas – a IA pode ajudar em qualquer tarefa criativa.

- Apoio à saúde mental: Ajuda nos momentos difíceis, reduzindo o estresse e a ansiedade com o auxílio da IA.

Experimente o ChatAI Assistant e descubra um novo nível de conforto e eficiência no seu dia a dia!

Baixe o ChatAI Assistant agora e comece a aproveitar todas as funcionalidades do aplicativo!

record.description_evidence:
Meet Neomi – Your Smartest Companion at Neo  

Neomi is your intelligent, enterprise-ready AI assistant that helps you get more done – smarter and faster.   

Whether you are in client servicing, operations, HR, or sales, Neomi understands your workflows and helps you streamline, automate, and simplify – one chat at a time.  

What Makes Neomi Powerful:  

 - Unified Conversations: Ask, instruct, or chat with Neomi using simple, natural language. No jargon, no fuss.  

 -  Personalized Intelligence: Neomi adapts based on who you are – banker, admin, or client – offering role-specific insights and actions.  

-   Proactive Assistance, not Just Reactive: Neomi doesn’t just wait for commands. It schedules reminders, flags pending items, and pushes timely alerts.  
-   Works Across Channels: Whether it’s your email, or internal dashboard – Neomi integrates seamlessly.  

 Client Relationship Hub: Manage client data, meetings, updates without switching apps.  

What You Can Do with Neomi:   

Get real-time updates, analytics, and workflow nudges.  
Accelerate internal collaboration by reducing context-switching.  
Ensure secure, role-based access through biometrics and internal authentication.  
Enterprise-Grade Security:  
Built for a regulated environment like wealth and asset management, Neomi uses role-aware workflows, access controls, and encrypted data protection.  

Impact You Can Measure:  

Saves time across teams by reducing manual effort.  
Boosts productivity, especially if you are a banker.  
Increased employee engagement with timely updates.  
Compliant and secure at all times.  
Neomi isn’t just an assistant – it is your AI-powered co-pilot at work.  

Download now and transform the way you operate.
